syncSegmentsEn.text: Words from my heart can never be enough
A pair of nail-scarred hands knock on a long-closed door
A gentle voice captures our hearts
Though I know this road is the way of the cross
With fierce wind and rain, the way is hard and bitter
The Lord’s loving hand always holds mine
There is no reason not to walk the road before me
